title: COPILOT stores without an _xlfn. prefix in Excel 16.0.20430, is service-deferred in DNA Calc, and left Excel on 2026-09-14
statement: In Excel 16.0 build 20430, COPILOT(prompt_part1, [context1], ...) was stored in OOXML without an _xlfn. prefix (excel-prefixes.json: =COPILOT(1) stored as COPILOT(1)). Microsoft's function page states that COPILOT left Excel on 14 September 2026 (so recalculating previously saved cells yields #NAME?). Evaluation is deferred as ExternalService in DNA Calc, with zero Excel calculation answers recorded.
basis: Based on Excel 16.0.20430 workbook storage in DnaCalc crates/calc-doc/tests/fixtures/d1/excel-prefixes.json, DnaCalc's catalogue deferral in crates/calc-catalogue/src/unheld.rs, and Microsoft's COPILOT function documentation cited in FUNC.COPILOT.json.
inferred: That COPILOT recalculation after 14 September 2026 returns #NAME? and its exact runtime coercion/rate-limit rules are inferred from Microsoft's published withdrawal notice rather than recorded Excel calculation captures (zero calculation rows exist in CalcFunc-Evidence).

evidence.note: Deferred by policy; Microsoft withdrawal date 14 September 2026

open: No Excel calculation rows for COPILOT are recorded; recalculation behaviour post-withdrawal (#NAME?) has not been captured locally.
